scope: Original AP MDR1 ID, GMP/TRE public headers, bounded TRE levels table; exact static metadata/rescale path.

static_dataflow.TRE_table_read: 0x2D062E extracts header+37 length; 0x2D065A extracts header+33 offset; 0x2D068E reads original table
static_dataflow.table_store: 0x2D093C stores second byte at object+0x40+low7level+0x16; 0x2D09AE stores minimum low7level at object+0x68
